title: Follow Christ First. Lead Her Second.
caption:
You can't lead her to a place you don't go yourself.

A lot of guys think leading a relationship means having the answers, setting the pace, being the strong one. It's simpler and harder than that. It's following Christ first, in private, before you ever try to lead anyone toward Him.

Get your own walk right. Say the hard thing early. Point her to God instead of becoming her god. Give her a real answer instead of a maybe.

Follow Christ first. Lead her second. Do it in that order and it stops being complicated.

#faith #christianman #godlyrelationship #discipleship #manofgod
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
